items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: Yeah, we were under the wing of Franklin Roosevelt at that time. Franklin Roosevelt had various rules...

ctx.x: Was the band on salary during that time that you had? Yeah, yeah, yeah.

Yeah, we were under the wing of Franklin Roosevelt at that time. Franklin Roosevelt had various rules, you know, if a radio station made a certain amount of money, they were going to have to hire a certain number of men. Well, WSMB made enough money to hire six men, so they had to hire six men. What the heck, it wasn't any skin off of that pocketbook. No. Lord have mercy, they had to give it to the government in income tax anyway. It's ridiculous. Well, as soon as the Taft-Hartley law was passed, they canned us.…

Is there anything about the New Orleans style? I was trying to see if you could point out any difference if you heard the New York bands that were different. I know at other times over last year you were going to explain once to me about different ways New Orleans...
